node.title: Dominant-component rank amplification at the strict endpoint
node.statement: At the official first strict endpoint, maximal separation rank m+1 of the full primitive generator propagates through its irreducible factorization. For every component Q_i of parameter degree e_i, sr(Q_i)>=ceil((m+1)/(m-e_i+1)). For the unique dominant component, its complement has parameter degree b=m-e_*<=floor((O-E)/4)<=m/4-1, so sr(Q_*)>=ceil((m+1)/(b+1))>=5. If b=0, Q_*=Q has exact rank m+1. Thus all rank-three and rank-four mixed dominant models are excluded; rank-five-or-higher models remain open.
